content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the case involved a divorce between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the applicant requested the dissolution of the marriage due to the defendants fault and also wanted to retain their married name and personal liabilities the defendant agreed with the application and stated that they also wanted a divorce the court decided that the movable property a car called renault espace would remain the personal property of the applicant the court also determined that the applicant would be personally liable for certain debts and that the party in whose favor the decision is made must pay the costs of the proceedings the applicant was granted stateguaranteed secondary legal aid exempting them from paying stamp duty costs the defendant was ordered to pay the stamp duty and the costs of sending procedural documents the court upheld the applicants request for a full dissolution of the marriage with the applicant retaining ownership of the car and the defendant being responsible for the applicants outstanding liabilities the defendant was also ordered to cover the states costs for secondary legal aid
